mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.perm_code IS NOT NULL AND p.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT u.* FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.code = #{roleCode} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.id

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(r.data_scope = 'ALL') > 0 THEN 'ALL' WHEN SUM(r.data_scope = 'DEPT') > 0 THEN 'DEPT' WHEN SUM(r.data_scope = 'BRAND') > 0 THEN 'BRAND' WHEN SUM(r.data_scope = 'CATEGORY') > 0 THEN 'CATEGORY' ELSE 'ALL' END AS scope FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0
